name: side-chat-advisor
description: Watches each prompt before it is sent and, when it looks like a quick tangent or lookup better suited to a Side Chat, shows a brief non-blocking suggestion with the reason. Deterministic rules only: no model calls, never blocks or rewrites the prompt.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Suggest a Side Chat when a prompt looks like a quick tangent. /sidechat-advisor on|off overrides this for the current install.

sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: low suggests only clear tangents, medium is balanced, high suggests more often.

showToast.title: Show toast
showToast.description: Show a short toast with the suggestion.

showBand.title: Show band above prompt
showBand.description: Show a dismissible band above the prompt with the suggestion and reason.

cooldown.title: Cooldown (prompts)
cooldown.description: Minimum number of prompts between two suggestions.
